effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

bio: Magmablood loremasters proclaim that Cindrake's first Invokation caused the volcanoes of the Thursian Mountains to erupt at once, blanketing Amara with ash. Other Ironbands dismiss this as Magmablood mythmaking, but Cindrake's face-melting power cannot be denied. Its flames were brought to terrifying effect during the war with the Saurin, melting many a vile machine into burning slag.
